* Body

Early thinking on JWT usage in checkout assumed symmetric signing and a single issuer. The deep-dive revealed that asymmetric RS256 keys, combined with a key-id header, would support rotation and multi-region validation. This concept note records the pre-refactor assumptions that were later challenged by the token expiry incident. It is superseded by the token expiry concept which incorporates post-incident learnings.
